name: saltix-grains
description: SDKs and tools for grains, apps that open inside Saltix wallets (Saltix 12-grains, docs/protocol/grains.md)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && npm run build:simulator
scripts.example: npm run build --workspace packages/server && node examples/hello-grain/server.mjs
scripts.support-agent: npm run build --workspace packages/server && node examples/support-agent/server.mjs
